chat.author: John Gray
chat.text: Landmark subtree proofs that update your landmarks from your latest local copy to the latest landmarks can be done with a LogN number of subtree proofs, so even if you haven't updated landmarks for days or longer, the amount of material needed isn't huge (yes, you still need a signature to a checkpoint) and a  set of subtree proofs.   Making efficient distribution  of landmarks is in scope for draft-gray-plants-mtc-ldp.   Also, the way it is being written, transparency is not a requirement, but if you want transparency you can have it.  Not all private PKI operators want/need transparency.

chat.author: Christopher Patton
chat.text: Well, this would force you to create such a cert repository, since the inclusion proof certifies the presence of the cert in the log
